name: veracross-plus
description: Enhanced Veracross portal experience with homework checklists on timeline and daily schedule pages, grade estimation, custom assignments, and navigation improvements

scripts.dev:chrome: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --target chromium
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --target firefox-desktop --firefox deved
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../veracross-plus-v$npm_package_version.zip .

author: Veracross Plus Team
